# Easy Rent — Project Documentation Index

**Last Updated:** 2026-07-10
**Deep-Dives:** 1
**Generated by:** BMAD `document-project` workflow (deep-dive mode)

Easy Rent is a verified mid-to-long-term (1–12+ month) house-rental marketplace for Sri Lanka (Next.js 15 App Router · React 19 · Drizzle · Supabase · Vercel). See `CLAUDE.md` for architecture and product invariants.
